title: Changes to PredicateBuilder breaks existing apps
body:
### Steps to reproduce
I'm having trouble creating reproduction steps for this one, so I'm posting my Sentry log to see if anyone can help me track it down.

The error I'm getting is this one
```
uninitialized constant ActiveRecord::PredicateBuilder::BaseHandler
Did you mean?  ActiveRecord::PredicateBuilder::BasicObjectHandler
```

My best guess is that it was caused by a1d236e93110a91d5fd7555cf8f84c8a98680cc3 @kamipo since it was the one that removed the `BaseHandler` and the first one where the problem showed for me.

Sentry indicates it is breaking in this block of code. It is marking the first line as the one responsible, but I'm not sure if the problem is really here, or if its in the lines inside.
```
tags = Rails.cache.fetch("#{table_name}/#{Tag.maximum(:updated_at).utc.to_s(:usec)}/tags") do
    includes = { tags: :invitation_templates }

    tags = []
    tags << Category.invitation_template_search(includes: includes).tags
    tags << Category.invitation_template_event_type(includes: includes).tags
    tags << Category.invitation_template_theme(includes: includes).tags
    tags.flatten!
end
```

I've tried make my dev env cached, running this fetch, upgrading rails to the ref that causes problem and hitting it again, but no luck. I've also tried without the cache, again no problem. But as soon as it moves into production, it breaks almost every (every?) time it hits this line

### Expected behavior
Fetch returns the values that  cached

### Actual behavior
Rails throws an error

### System configuration
**Rails version**: a1d236e93110a91d5fd7555cf8f84c8a98680cc3
**Ruby version**: 2.7.1
